Irreducible Perron splitting exponentially damps r, the weighted mean has only quadratic transverse error, and all coordinate constants coalesce. The exact commuting tangent-matrix integral gives time exponent -3W/2 in the log(t) factor. These proof steps, asymptotic domains and limits were reconstructed; symbolic checks verified the coefficients and numerical integration corroborated the bounds, with no extrapolation from finite time.

value.rationale: The logistic bifurcation cusp is an intrinsic, motivated borderline of a published strict contraction theorem, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The theorem closes global stability precisely at equality, quantifies universal t^-1/2 critical aging and the -8/5 logarithmic term, proves an irreducible/reducible distinction at the finite phase constant, and resolves how network eigenvalues affect subleading time-dependent perturbations. Those facts cannot be read from an equilibrium-only bifurcation diagram and are relevant to the lag in synchronization after an animal chorus threshold. It neither claims field-data validation nor a general theorem for unequal thresholds.
